content: Paulo na Banaba bhakabya ku Ikonio

Ku Ikonio mambu ghakabhi ngati moghakabheli ku Antiokia, Paulo na Banaba bhakapiti mu nyumba ja kuhimanganila Bhayahude ngati mowabheli ntetu wabhu. Monihomu bhakalongi kwa uwezu ukolongwa mbaka lipogha likolongwa la Bhayahude na Bhagiliki bhakahobhalile.
Nambu Bhayahude bhabhakaniki kubha bhahobhalela bhakabhachokaki na kujeghe maholalelu mahakau mu mitima ja bhandu bhangakubha Bhayahude nahuli bhabhakana bhalongu bhanihabha.

Bhela Paulo na Banaba bhakajendali kutama konihoku kwa chikahi chilacho. Bhakalandili kwa makakala makolongwa panani jaka Bambo, na Chapanga akaulangihi kubha ubholu waki wa chihomu chaki nde wa chakaka kwa kubhapekeha makili gha kutenda nginyulila na ngangachu.
Bhandu bha muchi ghonihoghu bhakalekangine. Bhangi bhakabhi papamu na Bhayahude, na bhangi bhakabhi upambala wa mitumi.
Bhayahude na bhandu bhangakubha Bhayahude, bhakajangatini na ihongozi bhabhu, bhakapangiki kubhahenge mahakau mitumi na kubhalapu maganga.
Mitumi pabhamanyi lijambu leniheli, bhakakembali ku michi ja Listila na Delibe, jejibhi mu inchi ja Likaonia na pa inchi yeilindakani na muchi ghonihoghu.
Konihoku bhakabhi bhatangaza Malobhi Manyahi.
Paulo na Banaba bhakabya ku Listila na ku Delibe
Ku muchi wa ku Listila kukabhi na mundu jumu joakatengwiki magholu kutumbu kubhelakeka kwaki na ngacheakawahiki kujenda.
Mundu jonihoju akabhi anjowanela Paulo paakabhi atangaza. Paulo akundingalakili na paakumbweni kubha abhi na uhobhalelu wa kulamiswa,
akajamalili akapwaghaje, “Ujemaje kwa magholu ghaku!” Palapala mundu jola akahombiki manyata na kutumbu kujenda.
Lipogha la bhandu pabhaweni cheakahengiki Paulo, bhakatumbwi kujamalila kwa lugha ja Kilikaonia bhakapwaghaje, “Ichapanga ituhikili kwa ubhonikanu ngati bhandu!”
Banaba bhakundohiki Zeu, na kwa kubha Paulo nde ndongela nkolongwa, bhakundohiki Helime.

Mpenganyambiku wa nyumba jaka kichapanga Zeu jejakabhi kunja ja muchi akaletiki mapongu gha ng'ombi na malobha palongi ja ndyangu wa muchi, jombi papamu na bhandu bhangi bhala akapaliki kubhatambikila mitumi bhala.
Nambu Banaba na Paulo pabhajowini mambu ghanihagha bhakaikachwi ingobhu yabhu na kukembalela mu lipogha la bhandu bhakajamalyaje, na kupwagha,

“Bhalongo, bho, maghambu kiki muhenga mambu ghanihagha? Tepani twa bhandu pela ngati mabhanganya! Tubhi pambani kwa ndandi ja kuntangazila Malobhi Manyahi, nahuli muilekaje imong'umong'u hinu yanga na chindu, na munkelabhukya Chapanga joabhi mwome, joabhombiki kunani kumahunde na ndema, bahali na yokapi yeibhi mkati ja hindu yeniheyi.
Pamwandi Chapanga akabhalekiki bhandu bhokapi bhahenga ngati mobhapalilaje.
Nambu Chapanga ngacheakotwiki kulilangiha kwa mambu manyahi ghaabhahengela. Kuntonyela iyula kuhuma kunani, ampeke mahunu kwa chikahi chaki, ampeke chilebhi na kujitwelakela mitima jinu kwa chiheku.”
Papamu na kulonge bhenibhela ngachekwabhi kupepuka kubhahibhali bhandu, nahuli ngabhabhokela nyambiku.

Bhayahude bhakumu bhakahikili kuhuma ku muchi wa ku Antiokia na ku Ikonio, bhakabhaswembiki bhandu bhalilomba nabhu, bhakundapwi maganga Paulo na kunhutana mbaka kunja ja muchi bhakaholakya kubha apotile.
Nambu bhabhulwa pabhakalibhongini na kumuyongolota Paulo, akajumwiki na kukelabhuka kumbwane. Chilabhu jaki jombi na Banaba bhakapiti ku Delibe.
Paulo na Banaba bhakelabhuka ku Antiokia ja ku Silia
Paulo na Banaba bhakatangizi Malobhi Manyahi ku Delibe na kubhapata bhabhulwa bhamahele. Kubhoka panihapa bhakakelawiki ku Listila, bhakapiti mbaka ku Ikonio na kuhika ku Antiokia.

Konihoku bhakabhachengiki bhahobhalela bha michi jeniheji na kubhajeghe mtima bhahighalya mu uhobhalelu wa chakaka. Bhakabhapwaghile, “Itupalika tabhokapi kupetela mang'ahiku ghamahele nahuli tujingala mu Ukolongwa waka Chapanga.”
Mu kila likanisa bhakabhahawi ihongozi kwa ndandi ja bhahobhalela, na kwa kulobha na kukonga bhakabhabhehi palongi jaka Bambo jobhunhobhalile.
Pabhapetiki inchi ja ku Pisidia, bhakahiki ku Pamfilia.
Pabhakajomwi kutangaza Lilobhi laka Chapanga kwa bhandu bha ku muchi wa ku Pega, bhakapiti ku muchi wa ku Atalia.
Kubhoka konihoku bhakakelawiki kwa sitima mbaka ku Antiokia, konihoku punyuma bhakabhekakiki pahi ja ulingalilu wa chihomu chaka Chapanga kwa ndandi ja lihengu ambalu sajenu bhalijomwile.

Pabhahiki ku Antiokia, bhakahengiki uhimanganu na likanisa la panihapa, bhakabhapeki ubholu panani ja mambu ghaabhahengi Chapanga, na ntundu mobhahoghulili bhandu bhangakubha Bhayahude ndyangu wa kujingila mu uhobhalelu.
Bhakatami ku Antiokia kwa machobha ghamahele papamu na bhabhulwa.
